description: Reverse geocode. Look up properties by latitude/longitude coordinates (reverse geocoding). Returns the closest property within 300 feet. Requires user approval and confirmed=true before changes or credit use. Writes are never retried automatically.

contact_audience.description: Which contacts to include with matched properties. Returned contacts consume people credits. Use "none" for property data only with zero people credits.

data.description: Array of coordinates to look up (max 250)

fields.description: Field IDs from GET /v1/fields. People fields return on each person; property fields return under property.

confirmed.description: Set true only after the user approves this change or credit use.

name: dealmachine_post_enrichment_reverse_geocode
